metadata.overview: Reports EMCD Bitcoin pool hashrate, active workers, mining balance and daily earnings over the read-only Pool API v1.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Current pool-side hashrate across configured accounts.

telemetry.name: balance
telemetry.description: Credited mining balance across accounts, excluding funds blocked for payout. Unavailable when the key lacks master:read:balance or the API lacks /balance.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Previous UTC day mining earnings, used as an estimate for today.

troubleshooting: If alert.pool_unreachable, verify apiUrl, apiKey, apiSecret, key permissions and outbound HTTPS connectivity.
If alert.hashrate_low, cross-check the fleet's own hashrate before escalating.
